name: syns
description: Pull on Codex session start and sync on every turn-stop, continuing the agent only when a resolution is required.

interface.shortDescription: Pull a Syns repository on start; sync it on Stop.
interface.longDescription: Lifecycle hooks that pull a joined Syns repository on startup/resume and sync it on every turn-stop, continuing the turn only when a resolution is required. Bundled hooks require trust, and changed hooks must be trusted again.
